## What kind of system this is

**eShop is a .NET Aspire–orchestrated, microservices-based e-commerce reference application** ("AdventureWorks") — a distributed set of ASP.NET Core services, background workers, a Blazor Server storefront, and two .NET MAUI mobile clients, wired together by an Aspire AppHost that also provisions Redis, RabbitMQ, and PostgreSQL containers (`README.md:1-3`, `eShop.slnx:1-36`).

Communication is mixed: HTTP/REST between web and APIs, gRPC to the basket service, and RabbitMQ integration events between services (`src/Basket.API/Program.cs:6,12`, `src/PaymentProcessor/Program.cs:5-6`).

## The single runnable entry point

**`src/eShop.AppHost`** is the one thing you run. It is an Aspire AppHost (`<Project Sdk="Aspire.AppHost.Sdk/13.2.0">`, `OutputType=Exe`) whose `Program.cs` *is* the composition root: `DistributedApplication.CreateBuilder(args)` … `builder.Build().Run()` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:3,103`). Launch it with `dotnet run --project src/eShop.AppHost/eShop.AppHost.csproj`, or open `eShop.Web.slnf` in Visual Studio with `eShop.AppHost.csproj` as startup (`README.md:68-76`). The Aspire dashboard listens on `https://localhost:19888` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Properties/launchSettings.json`).

## Processes that start when the solution runs

Each of these is added by an `AddProject<...>` call in the AppHost:

| Resource name | Project | Kind |
|---|---|---|
| `identity-api` | Identity.API | ASP.NET Core web API / IdentityServer, externally exposed, `/health` check (`Program.cs:23-26`) |
| `basket-api` | Basket.API | gRPC service (`Program.cs:30`; `src/Basket.API/Program.cs:6,12`) |
| `catalog-api` | Catalog.API | ASP.NET Core web API (`Program.cs:36-38`) |
| `ordering-api` | Ordering.API | ASP.NET Core web API, owns the EF migrations (`Program.cs:40-44,49`) |
| `order-processor` | OrderProcessor | Worker SDK host running the `GracePeriodManagerService` hosted service (`Program.cs:46-49`; `src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:19`) |
| `payment-processor` | PaymentProcessor | Event-bus subscriber for `OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent` (`Program.cs:51-52`; `src/PaymentProcessor/Program.cs:5-6`) |
| `webhooks-api` | Webhooks.API | ASP.NET Core web API (`Program.cs:54-57`) |
| `mobile-bff` | — (YARP resource) | Reverse proxy / BFF routing to catalog, ordering, identity (`Program.cs:60-62`; routes in `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:185-249`) |
| `webhooksclient` | WebhookClient | Web UI demo client (`Program.cs:65-67`) |
| `webapp` | WebApp | The storefront — Blazor with interactive server render mode (`Program.cs:69-77`; `src/WebApp/Program.cs:8,30`) |

Plus three container resources: `redis`, `eventbus` (RabbitMQ, persistent lifetime), and `postgres` (image `ankane/pgvector`, persistent) hosting four databases — `catalogdb`, `identitydb`, `orderingdb`, `webhooksdb` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:7-18`).

## What composes them

`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs` alone. It:
- Declares infrastructure, then wires each service with `.WithReference(...)` / `.WaitFor(...)` for connection strings and startup ordering (`Program.cs:30-57`).
- Injects cross-service URLs as environment variables — `Identity__Url` into basket/ordering/webhooks, `IdentityUrl` into the UIs, and a cyclic set of callback URLs back into identity-api (`Program.cs:33,44,57,67,77,97-101`).
- Picks the `http` vs `https` launch profile from the `ESHOP_USE_HTTP_ENDPOINTS` env var (`Program.cs:20,108-115`).
- Has two opt-in AI paths, **both hard-coded off**: `useOpenAI` and `useOllama` are `false`, so no OpenAI or Ollama resource starts by default (`Program.cs:80-90`; helpers at `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:52,164`).

`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:22-47` also forces `ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true` onto every project resource via a `BeforeStartEvent` hook.

## Not started by the AppHost

Two runnable apps exist in `eShop.slnx` but are **not** referenced by the AppHost and must be launched separately from a device/emulator target:
- **`src/ClientApp`** — .NET MAUI native app, entry `MauiProgram.CreateMauiApp()` (`src/ClientApp/MauiProgram.cs:23-27`), multi-targeting android/ios/maccatalyst/windows.
- **`src/HybridApp`** — MAUI Blazor Hybrid app reusing `WebAppComponents`, entry `MauiProgram.CreateMauiApp()` (`src/HybridApp/MauiProgram.cs:12-34`). It talks to the `mobile-bff` YARP proxy at a hard-coded `localhost:11632` (`src/HybridApp/MauiProgram.cs:9`), so the AppHost must already be running.

The remaining projects are libraries, not processes: `eShop.ServiceDefaults`, `EventBus`, `EventBusRabbitMQ`, `IntegrationEventLogEF`, `Ordering.Domain`, `Ordering.Infrastructure`, `WebAppComponents` (`eShop.slnx:6-19`).

One caveat: I confirmed the MAUI apps are absent from the AppHost by reading `Program.cs` end to end — there is no `Projects.ClientApp` or `Projects.HybridApp` reference in it — but I did not check whether some external tooling (e.g. `azd`) launches them another way.

## What kind of system this is

eShop is a **.NET Aspire–orchestrated, services-based e-commerce reference application** ("AdventureWorks") — a distributed set of ASP.NET Core microservices plus a Blazor storefront, mobile clients, and messaging/background workers (`README.md:1-3`). It targets **.NET 10** (`src/Catalog.API/Catalog.API.csproj:4`), and the solution is `eShop.slnx` (`eShop.slnx:1-36`).

## The single runnable entry point

**`src/eShop.AppHost`** is the orchestrator and the startup project — an `Exe` built with the Aspire AppHost SDK (`src/eShop.AppHost/eShop.AppHost.csproj:1,4`). You run it with `dotnet run --project src/eShop.AppHost/eShop.AppHost.csproj`, or open `eShop.Web.slnf` in Visual Studio with `eShop.AppHost.csproj` as startup (`README.md:66-77`). Docker must be running (`README.md:64-65`). Everything else in the distributed app is started *by* the AppHost.

## Processes started when the solution runs

Composed declaratively in `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs`:

**Infrastructure containers**
- `redis` — Basket store (`Program.cs:7`)
- `eventbus` — RabbitMQ, persistent container lifetime (`Program.cs:8-9`)
- `postgres` — `ankane/pgvector` image, persistent (`Program.cs:10-13`), hosting four logical databases: `catalogdb`, `identitydb`, `orderingdb`, `webhooksdb` (`Program.cs:15-18`)

**.NET service projects** (each `AddProject<...>` launches its own process)
- `identity-api` — Duende IdentityServer + ASP.NET Identity over `identitydb`, externally exposed, health-checked (`Program.cs:23-26`; `src/Identity.API/Program.cs:5-18`)
- `basket-api` — a **gRPC** service backed by Redis (`Program.cs:30-33`; `src/Basket.API/Program.cs:6,12`)
- `catalog-api` — versioned minimal-API catalog (`Program.cs:36-38`; `src/Catalog.API/Program.cs:21`)
- `ordering-api` — versioned, authorized orders API; also owns the EF migrations (`Program.cs:40-44`; `src/Ordering.API/Program.cs:19-22`)
- `order-processor` — a **Worker SDK** background service (`GracePeriodManagerService : BackgroundService`), waits for `ordering-api` because that runs the migrations (`Program.cs:46-49`; `src/OrderProcessor/OrderProcessor.csproj:1`; `src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:8-12`)
- `payment-processor` — headless RabbitMQ consumer subscribed to `OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent` (`Program.cs:51-52`; `src/PaymentProcessor/Program.cs:5-6`)
- `webhooks-api` — versioned webhook registration API over `webhooksdb` (`Program.cs:54-57`; `src/Webhooks.API/Program.cs:18-21`)
- `webhooksclient` — Blazor Server sample webhook subscriber (`Program.cs:65-67`; `src/WebhookClient/Program.cs:5,25-29`)
- `webapp` — the storefront: Blazor with interactive server components, externally exposed, labeled "Online Store" in the dashboard (`Program.cs:69-77`; `src/WebApp/Program.cs:8,30`)

**Reverse proxy**
- `mobile-bff` — a YARP resource (not a project) exposing catalog/ordering/identity routes to mobile clients (`Program.cs:60-62`; route table in `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:185-250`)

That's **10 project processes + 1 YARP proxy + 3 infrastructure containers**, plus the Aspire dashboard itself (`README.md:78-81`).

## What composes them

- **Wiring/composition** is entirely in `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs` — `WithReference` injects connection strings and service-discovery endpoints; `WaitFor` orders startup; `WithEnvironment` threads cross-service URLs (e.g. `Identity__Url`) and the cyclic identity→app callback URLs (`Program.cs:97-101`). HTTP vs HTTPS launch profile is chosen by the `ESHOP_USE_HTTP_ENDPOINTS` env var, for Playwright CI (`Program.cs:20,108-115`).
- **Shared cross-cutting composition** is `src/eShop.ServiceDefaults`: every service calls `AddServiceDefaults()` (or the lighter `AddBasicServiceDefaults()`), which adds OpenTelemetry logging/metrics/tracing with OTLP export, health checks, service discovery, and resilient HttpClient defaults (`src/eShop.ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs:16-48,50-106`), plus `MapDefaultEndpoints()` for `/health` and `/alive` in development (`Extensions.cs:108-125`).
- **Shared libraries** (not processes): `EventBus`/`EventBusRabbitMQ`, `IntegrationEventLogEF`, `Ordering.Domain`/`Ordering.Infrastructure`, `WebAppComponents` — all plain `Microsoft.NET.Sdk` or Razor class libraries.

## Runnable, but *not* started by the AppHost

Two .NET MAUI client apps are in the solution and must be launched separately per-platform — neither appears anywhere in `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs`:
- **`src/ClientApp`** — MAUI (XAML) mobile/desktop client, `UseMaui`, multi-targeted android/ios/maccatalyst/windows (`src/ClientApp/ClientApp.csproj:4-5,16-18`), entry point `src/ClientApp/MauiProgram.cs` with per-platform heads under `src/ClientApp/Platforms/`.
- **`src/HybridApp`** — MAUI Blazor Hybrid client reusing `WebAppComponents` (`src/HybridApp/HybridApp.csproj:1,4,16-18`), entry point `src/HybridApp/MauiProgram.cs`.

Both are also excluded from the `eShop.Web.slnf` filter used for the standard Visual Studio run (`eShop.Web.slnf:4-26`).

**One caveat:** I read the composition statically and did not build or run the solution, so I can't confirm runtime behavior (e.g. whether all containers start cleanly on this machine). Also note the two optional AI integrations — OpenAI/Azure OpenAI and Ollama — are gated behind `bool useOpenAI = false` and `bool useOllama = false` and therefore add **no** processes as the repo currently stands (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:79-90`); flipping either flag would add further resources (`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:52-183`).

answer:
## What kind of system this is

It's **eShop** — the .NET reference microservices e-commerce sample, orchestrated by **.NET Aspire**. It's a polyglot-of-one (all C#) distributed app: a set of ASP.NET Core services, two background workers, a Blazor web frontend, and two .NET MAUI client apps, all composed by an Aspire AppHost that also spins up the backing infrastructure containers. Solution file is the new XML format, `eShop.slnx` — there is no `.sln` (`eShop.slnx:1-36`, 24 projects across `/src/` and `/tests/`).

## The runnable entry point

There is exactly one thing you run: **`src/eShop.AppHost`** (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs`). It is the Aspire orchestrator — `DistributedApplication.CreateBuilder(args)` at `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:3`, `builder.Build().Run()` at `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:103`. Everything else is started by it.

## Processes that start when the solution runs

**Nine .NET service processes** (each `AddProject<>` in the AppHost):

| Resource name | Project | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `identity-api` | `src/Identity.API/Program.cs` | Duende IdentityServer, external HTTP (`Program.cs:23-26`) |
| `basket-api` | `src/Basket.API/Program.cs` | gRPC basket service over Redis (`Program.cs:30-33`) |
| `catalog-api` | `src/Catalog.API/Program.cs` | Minimal-API catalog (`Program.cs:36-38`) |
| `ordering-api` | `src/Ordering.API/Program.cs` | DDD/CQRS ordering, also runs EF migrations (`Program.cs:40-44`) |
| `order-processor` | `src/OrderProcessor/Program.cs` | Worker; `WaitFor(orderingApi)` (`Program.cs:46-49`) |
| `payment-processor` | `src/PaymentProcessor/Program.cs` | Worker on the event bus (`Program.cs:51-52`) |
| `webhooks-api` | `src/Webhooks.API/Program.cs` | Webhook subscriptions (`Program.cs:54-57`) |
| `webhooksclient` | `src/WebhookClient/Program.cs` | Demo webhook receiver UI (`Program.cs:65-67`) |
| `webapp` | `src/WebApp/Program.cs` | Blazor storefront, external HTTP (`Program.cs:69-77`) |

**Plus a YARP reverse proxy** `mobile-bff` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:60-62`) — not a solution project, a built-in Aspire resource; its routes are defined in `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:180-249`.

**Plus three infrastructure containers and four databases:**
- `redis` (`Program.cs:7`), parented to basket-api in the dashboard (`Program.cs:34`)
- `eventbus` — RabbitMQ, persistent lifetime (`Program.cs:8-9`)
- `postgres` — image `ankane/pgvector:latest`, persistent (`Program.cs:10-13`), hosting `catalogdb`, `identitydb`, `orderingdb`, `webhooksdb` (`Program.cs:15-18`)

## What composes them

`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs` is the composition root: it declares each resource, wires `WithReference(...)` dependencies (e.g. webapp → basket-api/catalog-api/ordering-api/eventbus, `Program.cs:69-77`), injects identity URLs as env vars, and sets health-check paths. Cross-cutting concerns (OpenTelemetry, health checks, service discovery, resilience) come from the shared `src/eShop.ServiceDefaults` library referenced by the services.

Three gates worth knowing (`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs`):
- `useOpenAI` is a **hardcoded `false`** local at `Program.cs:80` — the AI/semantic-search path (Azure OpenAI or OpenAI parameters, `Extensions.cs:64-145`) is off unless you edit that line.
- `useOllama` is likewise hardcoded `false` at `Program.cs:86`; enabling it adds an `ollama` container with OpenWebUI and two models (`Extensions.cs:165-170`).
- `ESHOP_USE_HTTP_ENDPOINTS=1` is the only real env gate (`Program.cs:20`, `Program.cs:108-115`); it switches launch profiles from `https` to `http`, intended for CI/Playwright.

## Not started by the AppHost

`src/ClientApp` (MAUI, `src/ClientApp/MauiProgram.cs`) and `src/HybridApp` (MAUI Blazor Hybrid, `src/HybridApp/MauiProgram.cs`) are in the solution (`eShop.slnx:20-21`) but are **not** registered in the AppHost — `Program.cs` contains no `Projects.ClientApp` or `Projects.HybridApp` reference among its nine `AddProject<>` calls (lines 23, 30, 36, 40, 46, 51, 54, 65, 69). They must be deployed/launched separately and pointed at the `mobile-bff` URL manually; nothing injects that address for them.

The remaining solution projects are libraries with no entry point: `eShop.ServiceDefaults`, `EventBus`, `EventBusRabbitMQ`, `IntegrationEventLogEF`, `Ordering.Domain`, `Ordering.Infrastructure`, `WebAppComponents` (`eShop.slnx:6-8,10,13-14,19`).

One caveat: I verified the AppHost composition and solution membership directly, but did not read each service's `Program.cs` body — the role descriptions in the table above are inferred from resource names, references, and the codebase's entry-point index (43 HTTP endpoints, 3 gRPC methods on `Basket`, 13 message consumers) rather than from reading each host file line by line.
